contract: the sizes libass requests when hinting is on (ASS_HINTING_NATIVE, LIGHT and NORMAL): every face of one font file read from memory and loaded at each of nine 26.6 pixel heights, after libass's GDI face metrics, with a REAL_DIM size request

outlines cases: the size metrics, libass's ascent and descent, HarfBuzz scale, emboldening strength, PostScript flag, underline and strikeout bands; the kerning at the size (FT_KERNING_DEFAULT) of every pair the kern table lists, nonzero values only; every glyph's FT_LOAD_NO_HINTING outline and advance, then that outline emboldened, slanted, and both
advances cases: every glyph's FT_LOAD_DEFAULT advance at that size; an advance the candidate cannot give ends its operation with an error, so the case fails
the file is read before each timed and memory operation; the reference library is created once, outside it
pending_module_requirements: gating the hinting modes: run by cargo xtask check once their policy is decided
hinted outlines and extents for NATIVE, LIGHT and NORMAL hinting
